subject_brief.one_sentence_goal: Draw a real-anatomy polar bear styled with Ralph Lauren identity cues and historical Black Panther Party-inspired clothing in a readable full-body composition.
must_have_parts: realistic bear head and muzzle proportions
must_avoid: Marvel/Wakanda suit assumptions unless explicitly requested
style_notes: Use real polar bear massing before costume detail.
Prefer a clean, iconic fashion silhouette over excessive line noise.
Keep the entire figure inside the calibrated canvas margins.

composition_plan.primary_subject_bbox_goal: occupy 35%-60% of drawable area unless task says otherwise
